title: Your EV Is Making Noise ON PURPOSE 🔊⚡ #shorts

scenes.text: Your electric car is secretly making noise. On purpose.
At low speed, EVs are almost silent. And that's dangerous for pedestrians, cyclists, and people who are blind.
So the law now requires a fake sound. It's called AVAS: Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System.
In Europe, it plays below twenty kilometers per hour. In the US, up to about thirty.
Go faster, and tire noise is loud enough on its own, so the speaker goes quiet.
Next time an EV hums past you in a parking lot, that's a speaker, not the motor. Follow EV Drive for a new car tech fact every day.
